newsitem.title: USA: Air Express Intl to build Dubai centre.
newsitem.headline: Air Express Intl to build Dubai centre.

text.p: Air Express International (AEI) said its second warehouse and distribution centre in the Middle East will be built in the Dubai International Airport Free Zone.
AEI already operates a centre in the Dubai Jebel Ali Free Zone.
AEI said the Dubai airport centre will serve as the freight forwarder's hub for the Middle East, Africa and the Commonwealth of Independent States.
It said the joint venture company, AEI Emirates LLC, has signed an agreement with the government of Dubai covering construction and operation of the 85,000-square-foot facility.
Construction will commence in November and be completed by next July, the company said.
